literal.prompt: Какой морской парк защищает огромную цепь коралловых рифов вдоль Квинсленда?

literalGroups.primaryGround: UNESCO GBR page L5 and L50 call it the world’s largest/most extensive coral reef ecosystem; L61 says it extends along Queensland; L82-L85 state most of the World Heritage property lies within the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park. Reef Authority page L15-L16 identifies the Marine Park Authority and its management/protection role. The exact marine-park entity is the key; the other options are terrestrial national parks.
